description: Team ARC brings together curious and ambitious minds passionate about astronomy, space science, robotics, programming, and AI. Our goal is to develop creative solutions to real-world challenges through science and innovation. We're looking for teammates skilled or interested in Python, AI, data science, physics, engineering, web development, UI/UX, graphic design, and research. You don't need to be an expert—creativity, teamwork, and a willingness to learn are what matter. Let's innovate beyond
